report_name: Indian Tech Firm i2k2 Networks and Others Suffer Data Breaches

threat_actors.name: Vexy
threat_actors.description: A threat actor that allegedly compromised the Indian data center and technology firm i2k2 Networks. The group is not widely known, suggesting it could be new or a rebrand.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for extortion or espionage.

threat_actors.name: Play
threat_actors.description: A financially motivated ransomware group that claimed responsibility for an attack on Grunthal Welding & Supplies Ltd. The group is known for double-extortion tactics.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

threat_actors.name: GlobalSecretGroup
threat_actors.description: A threat actor that compromised India LEI, an official Legal Entity Identifier registration agent, to acquire valuable business intelligence.
threat_actors.goals: Acquisition of sensitive corporate information for espionage or financial fraud.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The Play ransomware group is known to use this technique for initial access, exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities in public-facing services like Fortinet SSL VPNs and Microsoft Exchange.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Play ransomware group uses this technique to encrypt victim data as part of its double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The Play ransomware group exfiltrates victim data to pressure them into paying a ransom. Other groups like 'Vexy' and 'GlobalSecretGroup' are also suspected of using this for data theft.

malware.name: Play Ransomware
malware.description: A ransomware payload deployed by the Play threat actor group. It is known for double-extortion tactics, encrypting data and exfiltrating it to pressure victims into paying a ransom.

tools.name: AdFind
tools.description: A legitimate command-line Active Directory query tool often used by ransomware groups for reconnaissance.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: A Windows command-line tool used by attackers to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: nltest
tools.description: A Windows command-line tool used by attackers for domain discovery.

identities.name: i2k2 Networks
identities.description: An Indian data center and technology firm that was reportedly breached by the threat actor 'Vexy'.

identities.name: Grunthal Welding & Supplies Ltd.
identities.description: A manufacturing company attacked by the 'Play' ransomware group.

identities.name: India LEI
identities.description: An official Legal Entity Identifier registration agent in India, compromised by 'GlobalSecretGroup'.

indicators.name: Play Ransomware Note Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Play Ransomware Note Creation
id: 2b8c1d9e-4f5a-4b6c-8d7e-9f0a1b2c3d4e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a ransom note file named 'Play.readme', which is associated with the Play ransomware group.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-12
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\Play.readme'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the 'Play.readme' ransom note, a known indicator of Play ransomware activity.

indicators.name: AdFind Execution for Reconnaissance
indicators.pattern:
title: AdFind Execution for Reconnaissance
id: 3c9d2e0f-5a6b-4c7d-9e8f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of 'adfind.exe', a legitimate tool often abused by ransomware groups for Active Directory reconnaissance.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-12
tags:
  - attack.t1087.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\adfind.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of `adfind.exe`, a tool commonly used by ransomware actors for Active Directory reconnaissance.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 4d0e3f1a-6b7c-4d8e-af9a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-12
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of `vssadmin.exe` to delete backups, a common precursor to ransomware deployment.
